title: NitiBench+: A Temporal Thai Legal Question Answering Benchmark Across 17 Domains
abstract: arXiv:2611.03576v2 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Law changes over time. A court decides a case under the law in force on that day, and legal QA benchmarks grade answers against today's law. We checked 156,650 decisions of four Thai courts. Up to 67% of them cite law that has since been amended or repealed. We introduce NitiBench+, the sequel of our NitiBench, a Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains, built from decisions of three courts. For each cited section it holds both the text in force on the decision date and the current text, and its retrieval corpus holds every dated version of every Thai statute section. Answers are graded on the Thai Bar Council rubric, the Bar-standard score, and on the overlap between the cited sections and the court's. The report has two parts. translated_title: NitiBench+：一个涵盖17个领域的时序泰国法律问答基准
translated_abstract: 法律会随时间变化。法院依据判决当日有效的法律来裁决案件，而现有的法律问答基准却按照今天的法律来给答案评分。我们检查了泰国四个法院的156,650份判决，发现其中高达67%引用了此后已被修订或废止的法律。我们推出NitiBench+，它是我们此前NitiBench的续作，是一个泰国法律问答基准，包含基于三个法院判决构建的1,670个条目，覆盖17个法律领域。对于每个被引用的法条，该基准同时保存判决当日有效的文本和当前文本，其检索语料库则收录了泰国每一部法典每个条目的所有带日期的历史版本。答案的评分采用泰国律师公会的评分细则和律师标准分数，并根据模型引用的法条与法院实际引用法条之间的重合度进行评判。报告分为两部分：第一部分测量了使用错误文本在13个开放权重模型上造成的损失，阅读已修订法律的当前文本会使律师标准分数下降0.25，遗漏已废止法律则会使分数下降0.79。
tldr: NitiBench+是一个包含1,670个条目、覆盖17个领域、同时收录判决日有效与当前法条文本的泰国时序法律问答基准，实验表明模型使用过时法条文本会显著损害法律问答表现。
en_tdlr: NitiBench+ is a temporal Thai legal QA benchmark with 1,670 items across 17 domains that preserves both decision-date and current statute texts, showing that relying on outdated law significantly degrades model performance.
